statement:
Prove that triangle \(ABC\) is right-angled if and only if
\[\sin A + \sin B + \sin C = \cos A + \cos B + \cos C + 1.\]
Consider the polynomials \(f(p) = p^{12} - p^{11} + 3p^{10} + 11p^3 - p^2 + 23p + 30\) and \(g(p) = p^3 + 2p + m\). Find all integral values of \(m\) for which \(f\) is divisible by \(g\).
A plane \(\rho\) and two points \(M, N\) outside it are given. Determine the point \(A\) on \(\rho\) for which \(\dfrac{AM}{AN}\) is minimal.

Solve the system of equations:
\[\begin{cases} x^2+y^2+z^2+t^2=50 \\ x^2-y^2+z^2-t^2=-24 \\ xy=zt \\ x-y+z-t=0 \end{cases}\]

Let \(0 < p < q\) and let \(t_1, t_2, \ldots, t_n \in [p,q]\). Let \(A\) and \(B\) be the arithmetic means of \(t_1, \ldots, t_n\) and \(t_1^2, \ldots, t_n^2\) respectively. Prove that
\[\frac{A^2}{B} \geq \frac{4pq}{(p+q)^2}.\]

Two circles \(k_1\) and \(k_2\) with centers \(O_1\) and \(O_2\) touch externally at \(A\). Let \(M\) be a point inside \(k_2\) and outside line \(O_1O_2\). Find a line \(d\) through \(M\) meeting \(k_1\) and \(k_2\) again at \(B\) and \(C\) respectively, such that the circumcircle of \(\triangle ABC\) is tangent to \(O_1O_2\).
